name: APP_ENV
description: Environment name: staging or production

name: PROVIDERS_MODE
description: Always live in deployed environments

name: LOG_LEVEL
description: Server log level

name: AWS_REGION
description: Region of every regional resource

name: API_DOMAIN
description: Host name Caddy serves the API on

name: MCP_DOMAIN
description: Host name Caddy serves the MCP server on

name: CDN_DOMAIN
description: Host name of the CloudFront media distribution

name: ACME_EMAIL
description: Contact address for Let's Encrypt certificates

name: CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
description: Comma-separated https origins of the web app

name: TURNSTILE_EXPECTED_HOSTNAMES
description: Comma-separated host names Turnstile tokens must come from

name: STORAGE_BUCKET
description: Private media bucket

name: STORAGE_REGION
description: Region of the media bucket

name: STORAGE_FORCE_PATH_STYLE
description: false for AWS S3

name: BACKUP_BUCKET
description: Bucket for Redis backups

name: IMAGE_REPOSITORY_API
description: ECR repository URL of motionile-api

name: IMAGE_REPOSITORY_WORKER
description: ECR repository URL of motionile-worker

name: ECR_REGISTRY
description: ECR registry host used for docker login

name: CLOUDWATCH_LOG_GROUP
description: Log group the awslogs driver writes container logs to

name: SES_CONFIGURATION_SET
description: SES configuration set used for every message

name: EMAIL_FROM_DOMAIN
description: Verified SES sending domain

name: DATABASE_STATEMENT_CACHE_SIZE
description: 0 behind a transaction-mode pooler such as Neon's

name: CLOUDFRONT_KEY_PAIR_ID
description: ID of the CloudFront public key; present once the CDN is enabled

name: DATABASE_URL
description: Pooled PostgreSQL URL used by the application, postgresql://...

name: DATABASE_DIRECT_URL
description: Direct PostgreSQL URL used by migrations and workers, postgresql://...

name: REDIS_PASSWORD
description: Password of the Compose Redis service

name: SECURITY_PAGINATION_SECRET
description: At least 32 random characters that sign pagination cursors

name: ENCRYPTION_KEYS
description: JSON map of key version to base64 32-byte AES-GCM key, for example {"1":"<base64>"}

name: TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY
description: Cloudflare Turnstile secret key of this environment

name: CLOUDFRONT_PRIVATE_KEY
description: PEM private key that signs CloudFront cookies and URLs; used from Phase 9
